fn backend_launches(runner: &FakeRunner) -> Vec<Vec<String>> {
    runner
        .0
        .lock()
        .unwrap()
        .commands
        .iter()
        .filter(|command| {
            command.first().map(String::as_str) == Some("run")
                && command
                    .iter()
                    .any(|argument| argument.ends_with(".role=backend"))
        })
        .cloned()
        .collect()
}
